READABILITY.evidence: window.ts names read clearly (WindowFrameBoundary, assertFrameOffset, buildWindowClause) and has section headers and JSDoc on public helpers. Each .window() has a doc example matching the existing select-builder doc style. Code is dprint-formatted.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Spec and validation logic sits once in window.ts. Each dialect only adds an optional windows field, a 3-line .window() calling assertWindowName, and `const windowSql = buildWindowClause(windows);`. Built on sql.raw/sql.join with no string concatenation; file is ~453 lines.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: assertFrameOffset rejects non-integer and negative values and names the helper. Frame order is checked through `position`, and inverted unbounded boundaries are rejected. Window names, ntile and nthValue are validated. Numbers are inlined with sql.raw so they never become params.
